decisions.reason: The request to review chapter titles and subtitles does not change the independently defined styling of Mama's Hot Take content.
The source changes heading-formatting coverage but does not change image aspect ratio, cropping, pixelation, or rendering requirements.
Reviewing chapter titles and subtitles does not alter the dedication page content or its required removals.
The heading-formatting change does not alter chapter-image inclusion, selection, placement, timing, or full-page treatment.
The source contains no change to copyright-page attribution, alignment, email, or website content.
Chapter-title and subtitle review does not change the retained paragraph spacing or page-density decision.
The source does not change the editorial criteria, mapping, selection, or review of chapter images.
The first-page author-name question is a separate clause already represented by the candidate's same-message AMBIGUOUS Event; the chapter-heading modification requires no additional candidate MODIFY.
The source's chapter-heading formatting request does not revise manuscript wording, approved rewrites, or punctuation-proofreading requirements.
The source does not change the cover image, cover text, deliverable, design responsibility, or editorial cover review.
The manuscript-formatting request does not change the required publishing-process, readiness, or copyright guidance.
The source does not affect KDP keyword entry, upload assistance, delivery mode, or process support.
